statements.quote: Accelerated pursuit of growing artificial intelligence (AI) demand in the U.S. with the signing of a greater than $15 billion joint venture, expected to nearly triple the capital invested in the company’s xScale ® data center portfolio once completed
statements.notes: 'Greater than $15 billion' is a floor, so it is recorded as a single figure. This is the total capital of a joint venture with CPP Investments and GIC, not Equinix's own capex, and it covers xScale/hyperscale capacity with AI demand as the driver. The sentence names no year. Equinix's own 2024 capex guidance in p05 ($2.850–$3.100 billion total) is not linked to AI, so it is not recorded.
